Resolves relative Open Graph and Twitter card addresses and drops those the crawler cannot fetch

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine();
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.scrape(engine, url);
    stdout.writeln(result.statusCode);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.ogImage);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.twitterImage);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.ogUrl);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.ogVideo);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.ogAudio);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
